subject: CloudWave — final invoice, PO attached, VAT certificate and wire timing
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Emma Rosen <emma@cloudwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CloudWave — final invoice, PO attached, VAT certificate and wire timing

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for a productive renewal call last week. Attached is the final invoice for the July true-up (RW_Invoice_20270731_USD.pdf). A few items we need to close this out:

- Can you attach the PO number so we can map in our AR? (I see CloudWave uses PO references for all wires.)
- Do you prefer the invoice in EUR instead of USD? Accounting can reissue; let me know the currency and billing contact.
- For EU VAT, please confirm whether you will apply reverse-charge. If you need a vendor VAT certificate from Redwood, I can send that.

One operational note: per our contract Appendix B we retain a 5% escrow hold on the final tranche until post-termination SLA checks are complete. If you'd like to expedite, we can include an amendment to remove the escrow on sign-off. I can send a DocuSign amendment for a quick signature.

Target close: please let us know by EOD Monday so we can get the PO/invoice mapped for payment.

Thanks —
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com

Attachments: RW_Invoice_20270731_USD.pdf (invoice, 1 page, PDF)
From: Emma Rosen <emma@cloudwave.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudWave Billing <billing@cloudwave.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 18:35:00 +0200
Subject: Re: CloudWave — final invoice, PO attached, VAT certificate and wire timing

Hi Sergio —

Thanks for the invoice. Attached is our PO (CW_PO_7892.pdf) — please quote PO #7892 on the invoice. A couple of requests from billing:

- Can you reissue in EUR (our preference) and include a line item showing VAT treatment? We typically apply reverse-charge but need the invoice to detail net and VAT reference so our AR can process.
- We require your EU VAT registration certificate and vendor TIN to apply the reverse-charge correctly.
- Wire timing: our payments team is batching wires weekly; if you get us the EUR invoice and VAT certificate today, we should be able to schedule the wire for the next run (expected week of Aug 9).

Contact for payment: billing@cloudwave.com (cc'd).

Thanks —
Emma Rosen
Finance Manager, CloudWave Systems

Attachments: CW_PO_7892.pdf (purchase order, PDF)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: CloudWave PO / VAT handling (internal)

Sergio / Marissa — quick internal note after Emma's reply:

- CloudWave will apply reverse-charge. For EU AR to accept net invoice we need: Redwood EU VAT cert + vendor TIN on the invoice. I have the EU_VAT_Certificate_Redwood.pdf ready to attach.
- Accounting is asking whether we can show both EUR net and EUR gross columns (even if VAT=0 under reverse-charge) — that usually satisfies their reconciliation.
- Regarding the 5% escrow hold: they signaled they would prefer no escrow hold if we can provide SLA acceptance notes. For this renewal I'd recommend we offer to remove the escrow to speed payment since this client is strategic and has been compliant. Marissa, can you confirm CS sign-off to release the hold pre-wire?

I can produce the updated EUR invoice if you confirm the exact billing address and billing contact (billing@cloudwave.com).

-Karthik
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Emma Rosen <emma@cloudwave.com>, CloudWave Billing <billing@cloudwave.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 13:45:00 +0100
Subject: RE: CloudWave — final invoice, PO attached, VAT certificate and wire timing

Emma / Billing team —

Thanks for the PO. Attached is the reissued invoice in EUR that includes net/gross columns and references the reverse-charge (Redwood_Invoice_CW_EUR_20270731.pdf). I've also attached our EU VAT registration (EU_VAT_Certificate_Redwood.pdf).

Link to amendment (DocuSign) to remove the 5% escrow hold if you'd like to expedite: https://docusign.example/rw-cloudwave-amendment (one signature required from CloudWave to amend Appendix B). If you'd rather keep the standard escrow we will follow normal hold timelines.

Requested wire date: please confirm whether your payment batch on Aug 9 will include this. If so, we will mark as ready in our AR and plan for settlement.

Attachments: Redwood_Invoice_CW_EUR_20270731.pdf (invoice, 1 page), EU_VAT_Certificate_Redwood.pdf (certificate, 2 pages), DocuSign link: https://docusign.example/rw-cloudwave-amendment

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com
From: Emma Rosen <emma@cloudwave.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudWave Billing <billing@cloudwave.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 09:20:00 +0200
Subject: Re: CloudWave — final invoice, PO attached, VAT certificate and wire timing

Sergio —

All good on our side. PO #7892 is attached and has been routed. Our procurement signed the DocuSign amendment this morning (signed by L. Martin) so the escrow hold is removed. We expect to issue the EUR wire on Mon Aug 9 (estimated settlement Aug 10). Remittance stub attached (remittance_stub_0809.pdf).

Final request: can you confirm Redwood's bank details and IBAN for EUR wires one more time so our payments desk has the exact string? If you send those I will confirm once the wire is initiated.

Thanks for the quick turnaround — appreciate the help.
